thread:
Sam Ortiz: quick sync — daily standup format: what I did / blockers / today
Anya Patel: did: landed gw routing policy PR (GH #4987) to prefer region-local pools for EU traffic; added integration tests. blocker: seeing a few 429s in staging around 10k rps bursts. investigating. today: follow up on rate bucket tuning + telemetry.
Liam Chen: did: reviewed authz filter changes, left comments on GH #4992. blocker: need clarity on token cache TTL when rotating keys. can we standardize to 60s for cache invalidation?
Kevin Brooks: did: rolled forward canary for flow-control tweak (1.3.5 -> 1.3.6) to 10% traffic. DevDeployBot reported OK so far. blocker: none. today: prepare rollback playbook + smoke tests for token rotation.
Marta Alvarez: did: updated docs for per-route throttles and added example config for burstable endpoints. blocker: doc link in console still points to old schema. filing a small docs PR. today: sync with docs owner to update Console link.
DevDeployBot: deploy canary 1.3.6 -> gateway-pool-prod at 2026-03-17T12:18Z; traffic 10%; health checks passing (3m). :rocket:
Anya Patel: sample log from staging showing 429 spike (scrubbed):
```
[2026-03-17T11:05:02Z] ingress: route=/v1/generate client=acct-123 status=429 burst=812 tokens=5
[2026-03-17T11:05:02Z] quota: bucket=gw-default rate=1000/s burst=500 backlog=120
```
Liam Chen: thanks — can you paste the grafana link for the burst window? I want to check sequence length distribution and KV cache hit rate.
Anya Patel: here: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/ingress/burst-windows?orgId=1&from=1679040300000&to=1679040600000 — note the KV cache hit drops correlate with the 429s. suspect cache thrash on long convo tails.
Kevin Brooks: I pushed a quick experiment to increase per-shard bucket size by 20% in staging configs (config PR #4999). If this improves, we can roll to canary.
Marta Alvarez: re: docs PR — small change, will link to new schema once the console routing API finalizes (pinged @product).
Sam Ortiz: blocker for me: need a final decision on token rotation TTL (Liam suggestion 60s seems safe). also need volunteers to run the chaos test (10m failure injection) this afternoon.
Liam Chen: 60s TTL SGTM. I'll add tests to the auth integration job to assert no more than 2s additional latency under rotation.
Anya Patel: happy to run chaos window at 15:30 PT, canary watchlist on.
Kevin Brooks: I'll pair on rollback steps and stay on pager for the window.
Sam Ortiz: thanks team — action items: Anya tune buckets + run chaos @15:30, Liam add TTL test + merge GH #4992, Kevin finalize rollback doc, Marta watch docs link. quick ping if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
